However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-speciﬁc architectures. Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems. claims.context: We explore a general-purpose ﬁne-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) — models which combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation. We introduce RAG models where the parametric memory is a pre-trained seq2seq model and the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever. We compare two RAG formulations, one which conditions on the same retrieved passages across the whole generated sequence, and another which can use different passages per token. claims.quote: We ﬁne-tune and evaluate our models on a wide range of knowledge-intensive NLP tasks and set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks, outperforming parametric seq2seq models and task-speciﬁc retrieve-and-extract architectures.
claims.reason: 引用直接说明在三个开放域QA任务上达到SOTA并超越参数化seq2seq和专用检索抽取架构。

claims.context: We compare two RAG formulations, one which conditions on the same retrieved passages across the whole generated sequence, and another which can use different passages per token. We ﬁne-tune and evaluate our models on a wide range of knowledge-intensive NLP tasks and set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks, outperforming parametric seq2seq models and task-speciﬁc retrieve-and-extract architectures. For language generation tasks, we ﬁnd that RAG models generate more speciﬁc, diverse and factual language than a state-of-the-art parametric-only seq2seq baseline.

claims.proposal: the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claims.anchor: retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents
claims.context: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation [11], the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input. In these cases, once retrieval had collapsed, the generator would learn to ignore the documents, and the RAG model would perform equivalently to BART. The collapse could be due to a less-explicit requirement for factual knowledge in some tasks, or the longer target sequences, which could result in less informative gradients for the retriever.

fields.problem: 大语言模型易产生幻觉，尚不清楚其倾向生成何种内容及程度如何。
fields.method: 提出采样-过滤两阶段框架自动生成幻觉样本，并人工标注ChatGPT回答中的幻觉。
fields.dataset: HaluEval含35,000条幻觉/正常样本，包括5,000条通用查询和30,000条任务特定示例。
fields.conclusion: ChatGPT约19.5%回答含幻觉，现有LLM难以识别幻觉，但外部知识或推理步骤有帮助。
fields.limitation: 幻觉样本质量受ChatGPT指令遵循能力限制，且未探究幻觉产生的深层原因。

The construction pipeline of HaluEval is depicted in Figure 1.

The empirical results suggest that ChatGPT is likely to generate hallucinated content related to specific topics by fabricating unverifiable information (i.e., about 19.5% responses). Moreover, existing LLMs face great challenges in recognizing the hallucinations in texts. However, our experiments also prove that providing external knowledge or adding reasoning steps can help LLMs recognize hallucinations.

fields.problem: 现有检索增强语言模型多为一次性检索，难以应对长文本生成中持续变化的信息需求。
fields.method: 提出FLARE，迭代用即将生成句子的预测作为查询检索文档，低置信度时重新生成。
fields.dataset: 在4个长文本知识密集型生成任务/数据集上评测FLARE及基线。
fields.conclusion: FLARE在所有任务上取得优越或有竞争力的性能，证明方法有效。

claims.quote: Most existing retrieval augmented LMs employ a retrieve-and-generate setup that only retrieves information once based on the input.
claims.reason: 引用明确说明现有方法只基于输入检索一次，直接支撑“一次性检索”的核心内容。
claims.proposal: Most existing retrieval augmented LMs employ a retrieve-and-generate setup that only retrieves information once based on the input.
claims.anchor: only retrieves information once based on the input
claims.context: Augmenting LMs by retrieving information from external knowledge resources is one promising solution. Most existing retrieval augmented LMs employ a retrieve-and-generate setup that only retrieves information once based on the input. This is limiting, however, in more general scenarios involving generation of long texts, where continually gathering information throughout generation is essential. In this work, we provide a generalized view of active retrieval augmented generation, methods that actively decide when and what to retrieve across the course of the generation.

fields.problem: 大语言模型会自信地生成虚构事实，现有事实核查方法需输出概率分布或外部数据库，黑盒模型难以适用。
fields.method: 提出SelfCheckGPT：对同一提示随机采样多条回复，若某句被各采样一致支持则为事实，否则为幻觉；用BERTScor
fields.dataset: 用GPT-3基于WikiBio数据集生成人物段落，并人工标注生成段落的句子级与段落级事实性。
fields.conclusion: SelfCheckGPT能检测非事实与事实句子并按事实性排序段落，在句子级AUC-PR和段落级相关性上优于灰盒概率与熵方
fields.limitation: Prompt方法计算开销大；n-gram方法在改用WikiBio参考文本替代自采样时性能大幅下降。

claims.quote: Existing fact-checking approaches either require access to the output probability distribution (which may not be available for systems such as ChatGPT) or external databases
claims.reason: quote明确指出现有事实核查方法需输出概率分布或外部数据库，与claim核心一致。
claims.proposal: Existing fact-checking approaches either require access to the output probability distribution (which may not be available for systems such as ChatGPT) or external databases
claims.anchor: output probability distribution
claims.context: However, LLMs are known to hallucinate facts and make non-factual statements which can undermine trust in their output. Existing fact-checking approaches either require access to the output probability distribution (which may not be available for systems such as ChatGPT) or external databases that are interfaced via separate, often complex, modules. In this work, we propose "SelfCheckGPT", a simple sampling-based approach that can be used to fact-check the responses of black-box models in a zero-resource fashion, i.e. without an external database.

claims.quote: we propose "SelfCheckGPT", a simple sampling-based approach that can be used to fact-check the responses of black-box models in a zero-resource fashion

claims.anchor: simple sampling-based approach
claims.context: Existing fact-checking approaches either require access to the output probability distribution (which may not be available for systems such as ChatGPT) or external databases that are interfaced via separate, often complex, modules. In this work, we propose "SelfCheckGPT", a simple sampling-based approach that can be used to fact-check the responses of black-box models in a zero-resource fashion, i.e. without an external database. SelfCheckGPT leverages the simple idea that if an LLM has knowledge of a given concept, sampled responses are likely to be similar and contain consistent facts.

claims.context: Figure 3 demonstrated the performance change of Self-RAG and Self-CRAG on the PopQA dataset. It can be seen that the generation performance of Self-RAG and Self-CRAG dropped as the retrieval performance dropped, indicating that the generator relied heavily on the quality of the retriever. Furthermore, as the retrieval performance dropped, the generation performance of Self-CRAG dropped more slightly than that of Self-RAG. These results imply the superiority of Self-CRAG over Self-RAG on enhancing the robustness to retrieval performance.
